title: F2 Counter Increment
statement: For every Boolean list $x$, natural number $i<|x|$, and Boolean list $bs$, running the counter machine for $2\,\mathrm{carry}(bs)+2$ steps from state $0$, input-head position $i+1$, work-tape head position $0$, tape containing $bs$, and empty output yields state $0$, input-head position $i+2$, work-tape head position $0$, tape containing the binary increment of $bs$, and empty output.
